## 2d585b947291

**Possible shortcut with reproduced validator-clean counterexample: choose the
most frequent nonzero color globally instead of the largest connected object.**

Pinned generator SHA-256:
`f15d4f8820f1a0b00d0a147113667c206d9550846e78d29815e49c51425d0900`.
Selected Racket rule hash: `fc7666c321ac`.

Fresh census policy: 400 generated inputs per band, 1,200 total, seeds
`2585000 + band_index*100000 + sample_index`, sample indices 0–399. Every input
assigned exactly one connected object to each color, and the global-color-count
rival matched the intended largest-component output on all 1,200/1,200 inputs.
It also matches all 4/4 canonical pairs. Under this distribution, total count of
a color is exactly the size of its sole component, so connectivity is unnecessary.

The exact counterexample has a four-cell color-1 L object and two disconnected
three-cell color-2 bars. The target `self_check` returns no errors. The selected
Racket authority chooses and mirrors the four-cell color-1 component, yielding:

```text
[[0, 1],
 [0, 1],
 [1, 1]]
```

The global-frequency rival sees six color-2 cells and instead returns the union
crop of both color-2 bars:

```text
[[2, 2, 2],
 [0, 0, 0],
 [0, 0, 0],
 [2, 2, 2]]
```

The input is inside the target validator's accepted domain but outside its
ordinary declared generation invariant, because ordinary generation gives each
object a distinct color. That restriction is exactly why the shortcut survives.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/2d585b947291/counterexample.json` — exact input, authority and
  rival outputs, hashes, validator result, domain qualification, command, and cwd;
- `checks/audit/2d585b947291/racket.json` — raw supported authority application;
- `checks/audit/analysis.json` — 1,200-input census and 4-pair canonical check;
- reproduction command: `PYTHONPATH=repo/shared/runtime:repo/src python3 checks/audit/analyze.py`
  from packet root.

A future repair can reuse colors across disconnected objects and declare a
component-size-versus-global-frequency rival. No audit-target patch was made.
